  %\VignetteIndexEntry{13. Horizontal raster qualification}

---

The next prerequisite for Stream DEM assembly is a horizontal raster operation
that preserves elevation units and vertical-reference evidence. This increment
adds `warp_terrain_horizontal` to the fluvgeo backend. It is not yet an analyst
action, and FG Studio's existing preflight PASS still authorizes no processing.

The primitive takes a local source GeoTIFF, a GeoTIFF grid template and a new
attempt directory. The template's pixels are ignored. It accepts a bounded static
projected profile with the same identified base geodetic reference on both sides.
It selects an explicit exact, grid-free PROJ operation, uses a separate horizontal
source definition and disables GDAL vertical shifting. Full original compound
CRS evidence and band units remain in the manifest. Datum/epoch operations,
external sidecars, rotated grids and nonidentity scale/offset remain blocked.

The installed GDAL control test demonstrates the reason for these guards: a
default warp converts synthetic US-survey-foot heights to metres when targeting
a 2D metre CRS. The guarded path preserves the original magnitudes. This is
qualification of a specific processing profile, not vertical-datum accuracy,
modernized NSRS readiness or acceptance of a real source set.

Aligned output uses nearest sampling and exact cell-by-cell comparison with the
source at the chosen storage precision, including cropped windows and outside-source NoData. Other grids use
bilinear interpolation, verified with independent synthetic expectations.
Storage defaults to Float32; Float64 storage is explicit opt-in. Working precision
remains Float64. Aligned Float32 inputs retain exact samples; higher-precision
inputs are rounded when written as Float32. This rounding is independent of
elevation-unit conversion. Resource admission, bounded reads, reopening,
input/output hashes and a manifest written last support later worker orchestration.
The backend contract describes the limits and retained evidence in full.

Trace sibling fluvgeo `R/warp_terrain_horizontal.R`,
`tests/testthat/test_warp_terrain_horizontal.R` and
`dev/schemas/horizontal-terrain-warp.md`. The primitive reuses metadata inspection
and bounded block iteration. It has no current app caller; the app-only call map
therefore has no worker bridge to it yet. Existing application behavior and mask
creation remain unchanged.

The app's [source review workflow](dev-14-source-review.html) now records analyst
vertical/unit evidence and explicit overlap order. Next, assembly must bind those
decisions to receipt-verified source choices, a current mask edition and Event settings
to one cancellable assembly request. Compatible neighboring tiles must be assembled
with interpolation halos before warping; masks are applied after assembly. A
verified intermediate warp is not a completed or scientifically accepted Stream
DEM. The current source set still requires reconciliation; this implementation
does not authorize automatic datum or elevation-unit conversions.
